summary.en: Choose nested helpers by scope, capture and their need for an enclosing object.
summary.bn: কতটুকু জায়গায় দরকার আর বাইরের অবজেক্ট লাগে কি না বুঝে নেস্টেড ক্লাস বেছে নাও।

notes: Java 16 relaxed static-member restrictions in inner classes; the examples use Java 17.

sections.title: Place a helper near the code that owns its meaning
Construct the static and instance forms differently
Limit a named helper to one operation
Name the contract when the implementation is one-off
Do not assume nesting supplies every context
Keep helper scope and object links visible

examples.title: A static nested entry
examples.explanationHtml: The entry needs only its id, so creating it requires no Library object.

examples.title: Two enclosing instances
examples.explanationHtml: Each ticket reads the private name from its own enclosing library.

examples.title: A local class captures a rate
examples.explanationHtml: The rate is effectively final and remains available to Fee.total.

examples.title: An anonymous class keeps private state
examples.explanationHtml: The unnamed implementation has one counter field shared by its two invocations.

practice.title: A nested bill line
practice.statementHtml: Read price and count, each 0..1000. Use static nested Shop.Line and print price*count. No prompt.
hints: A bill line needs no enclosing shop instance.

practice.title: Capture a fee configuration
practice.statementHtml: Read rate and days (0..1000). Declare a local Fee class capturing both effectively final values. Print their product. No prompt.
hints: Assign the local configuration once before declaring Fee.

practice.title: Choose a listener form
practice.statementHtml: A listener reads a particular window field and lives only while that window is open. Which nested form is reasonable, and what lifecycle issue remains?
practice.answerHtml: An inner class can express the enclosing window association. Unregister the listener from longer-lived event sources when the window closes, so the listener does not retain the window unnecessarily.
hints: Follow the reference from the event source.

practice.title: Compare this in two callbacks
practice.statementHtml: How does this differ in an anonymous class and a lambda?
practice.answerHtml: In an anonymous class method, this is that anonymous object. A lambda does not introduce a new this; it uses the surrounding this when one exists.
hints: Ask whether a new instance context is introduced.

quiz.prompt: Does constructing Library.Entry require a Library instance?
quiz.explanation: The static nested helper stores the explicitly supplied id.

quiz.prompt: Which enclosing library does each inner ticket read?
quiz.explanation: Each inner instance remembers the Library used in its creation expression.

quiz.prompt: Does calling the same anonymous Runnable retain its private counter?
quiz.explanation: Both calls use one anonymous object, so its field reaches two.

quiz.prompt: Which form has an implicit enclosing instance?
quiz.explanation: An inner member is associated with a particular enclosing object.

quiz.prompt: What does Outer.this select inside Inner?
quiz.explanation: The qualified this distinguishes the two instance contexts.

quiz.prompt: Which local variable can a local class capture?
options: One that is final or effectively final
quiz.explanation: Capture requires a stable local variable binding.

quiz.prompt: Can a final captured list reference still refer to mutable contents?
options: Only when raw types are used
quiz.explanation: Final prevents reference reassignment rather than mutations through the reference.

quiz.prompt: Why can an inner listener retain its window?
options: Garbage collection never handles GUI objects
It can hold the enclosing instance reachable
quiz.explanation: The listener may keep an otherwise unused outer object reachable.

quiz.prompt: Which capability can an anonymous class provide beyond a lambda?
options: Extending a class with overridden methods
quiz.explanation: An anonymous class can extend a class; lambdas require a functional-interface target.

quiz.prompt: Is source nesting itself an is-a relationship?
options: No, inheritance still needs extends or implements
quiz.explanation: Lexical placement and subtype relationships are separate facts.

quiz.prompt: Does a static nested class forbid storing an explicit outer reference?
quiz.explanation: Static removes the implicit enclosing-instance association, not ordinary reference fields.

keyPoints.en: Static nested helpers need no automatic outer instance.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্যাটিক নেস্টেড ক্লাসের জন্য বাইরের অবজেক্ট লাগে না।

keyPoints.en: An inner object remembers its enclosing instance.
keyPoints.bn: ইনার অবজেক্ট তার বাইরের অবজেক্টের রেফারেন্স রাখে।

keyPoints.en: Local helpers keep names inside one block.
keyPoints.bn: লোকাল ক্লাসের নাম শুধু ওই ব্লকেই ব্যবহার করা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Captured local bindings must stay stable.
keyPoints.bn: ক্যাপচার করা লোকাল ভেরিয়েবলে পরে নতুন মান বসানো যায় না।

keyPoints.en: Anonymous classes can retain ordinary instance state.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যানোনিমাস ক্লাসের অবজেক্টেও সাধারণ ফিল্ডের মান থেকে যায়।

examQuestions.question: Compare all four nested class forms with use cases.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A static nested entry groups a helper without an outer instance. An inner ticket accesses one enclosing library. A local fee helper is scoped to one method and can capture configuration. An anonymous adapter supplies a one-off implementation.

examQuestions.question: Why can a listener keep a closed window in memory?
examQuestions.answerHtml: A registered inner listener can keep the enclosing window reachable. Remove the registration when its owner is finished. Garbage collection reclaims unreachable objects, not objects merely hidden from the screen.

examQuestions.question: Explain creation of north.new Ticket().
examQuestions.answerHtml: north supplies the enclosing Library instance. The new Ticket object can access north’s instance state through its implicit enclosing association.
